wrote:


> 
> 20. Notice the masochistic tendency of leftist tactics.  Leftists protest
> by lying down in front of vehicles, they intentionally provoke police or
> racists to abuse them, etc.  These tactics may often be effective, but 
> many leftists use them not as a means to an end but because they PREFER 
> masochistic tactics.  Self-hatred is a leftist trait.
> 

Masochistic?  No, I don't think so...at least not for the 
communists.  At least 10 to 15 million each killed in
collectivzation in Russian and China.


> 
> So is capitalism from the worker's perspective better or worse than
> slavery?  On one hand you are "free" to choose your master, but on
> the other, the money you are given goes for food and shelter that
> slavemasters would have previously covered.  Granted slavery was
> inhumane in its treatment of workers, but is capitalism anything
> more than a humane and complicated form of distributed slavery?
> 

If you don't like the job, then don't take it.  Go back to
whatever you were doing before you took it. 

Capitalism is, by its very definition, freedom -- not slavery.
Socialism is slavery.
